# Claude Skills by Polar Bear

> A GitHub repository of themed Claude Skill (Agent Skill) packs for Claude Code and Claude.ai. Each pack is an installable Claude Code plugin bundling several SKILL.md skills plus the reference files they share. Repository: https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills

Install in Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add polar-bear-org/claude-skills`, then `/plugin install <pack-name>@polar-bear-skills`.
Install on claude.ai: upload the per-skill zips from a pack's `install/` folder via Settings → Customize → Skills → Upload skill.
Install manually: copy `packs/<pack>/skills/*` into `~/.claude/skills/` or a project's `.claude/skills/`.

## Packs
- Employee Experience: packs/employee-experience-pack/README.md
- Team Performance: packs/team-performance-pack/README.md
- Stakeholder Relationships: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/README.md
- Failures and Mistakes: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/README.md
- Delegation: packs/delegation-pack/README.md
- Changing Ways of Working: packs/ways-of-working-change-pack/README.md
- Handling Disagreements: packs/disagreements-pack/README.md
- Time for Top Priorities: packs/top-priorities-pack/README.md
- Important Decisions: packs/important-decisions-pack/README.md

- [Workshop Pack](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/workshop-pack): 7 skills for running workshops, offsites, and facilitated sessions that end in decisions — intention framing, agenda design, pre-work communications, facilitator run sheet, live capture of walls and transcripts, 48-hour synthesis, and the facilitation retro.

- [Annual Review Cycle Pack](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/review-cycle-pack): 11 skills that run an annual performance review cycle without performance software — cycle planning, growth matrix, review forms, self-reviews, manager growth memos, 1:1 prep, and the end-of-cycle retro. Split by role: 6 skills for the founder or people lead, 3 for managers, 4 for employees.

- [Design Thinking Pack](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/design-thinking-pack): 33 skills that carry a design project from a fuzzy challenge to a tested, decision-ready concept — challenge framing, stakeholder and assumption mapping, interview guides, screeners, surveys, observation and diary studies, interview debriefs and transcript synthesis, insights, personas, JTBD, journey maps, POVs and How Might We questions, idea expansion, concept cards, prioritisation and DFV checks, storyboards and role-plays, prototype and test plans, and the stakeholder playback. Claude prepares and synthesises; humans meet the users.

- [Onboarding Pack](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/onboarding-pack): 12 skills that carry a new hire from "yes" to day 90 — the pre-boarding plan, the internal emails that get IT and finance moving, the cultural brief, the welcome pack, the per-joiner checklist and dashboard, the team deck, the team intro email, the first goals, the first week, and the joiner's own 90-day companion. Split by role: 7 skills for whoever runs onboarding, 4 for the hiring manager, 1 for the person joining. Claude prepares and keeps track; humans welcome.

- [Design Sprint Pack](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/design-sprint-pack): 13 skills for selling, running, and landing a design sprint — qualifying the ask before the proposal goes out, framing the challenge, casting the Decider and the room, recruiting five real testers, the five days from map and target through sketch, decision, storyboard, prototype and Friday's interviews, and the Monday after, where most sprints quietly end. For consultants, facilitators and founders at 20–200 person firms. Claude prepares, captures and synthesises; the heat map, the Decider's call and the five conversations stay human.

- [DesignOps Pack](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/designops-pack): 12 skills for making the invisible ops of a design team explicit and runnable — the map of how the team works today, then the critique ritual and the preparation of one session, the handoff standard and the check against it, design-system governance and the decision record for one change, file and tool conventions, the front door for requests, the capacity plan, a new designer's 30/60/90, and the handbook that compiles the lot. For design leads, ops leads and founders at design-driven firms of 20–200 people. Claude designs the rituals and keeps the records; the critique stays human — no skill judges a design, scores a designer, or ranks anyone's work.

- [Innovation Pack](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/innovation-pack): 12 skills for running an innovation program that tests real bets, kills most of them cheaply, and earns its next round of funding — the charter that lets a program say no, gates that ask one question instead of handing out scores, the innovation ledger, the portfolio map, challenge framing and ideation formats, discovery interviews, experiment cards with thresholds written before the test, the reading of results, the gate brief and signed decision, the investment case, and the sunset memo. For consultants, leads and founders at 20–200 person creative and digital firms. Evidence comes from the market and decisions come from named humans; no skill simulates a customer, scores an idea, or makes the kill call.

- [Employer Branding Pack](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/employer-branding-pack): 12 skills for an employer brand a joiner's first week does not disprove — the listening round of stay interviews, the map of what peer firms claim, the evidence base with its minority views kept, the EVP as Give and Get pairs with each claim tagged by evidence strength, the careers page that says the hard parts, the job ad that helps the wrong people not apply, the realistic job preview, a colleague's own post in their own voice, a quarter of hiring content with a willing owner per piece, measures that work at six hires a year, the week 1, 4 and 12 promise check with a joiner, and the quarterly review that sorts broken promises into fix-the-words and fix-the-workplace. For consultants, leads and founders at 20–200 person creative and digital firms. Every claim needs a living witness: no skill invents a quote, a testimonial, or a person.
- [Case Study Factory Pack](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/case-study-factory-pack): 10 skills for turning one thirty-minute interview about a delivered project into a case study in every format — the interview that writes the source file, the short web case for the work page, the long read in magazine shape, the one-pager and the two-pager built as real PowerPoint files, the single slide for the credentials deck, the LinkedIn post from the firm and the one from the lead, the award entry fitted to the form, the 120 to 180 word paragraph for a proposal or an RFP answer, and the 60 to 90 second video script. For consultants, leads and founders at 20–200 person creative and digital firms. Every case starts with a real interview and every number is the client's number with a named person behind it: Claude writes every format, it never supplies the experience, and it never gets the client's permission for you.

## Skills

### Workshop Pack

- [intention-framer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/workshop-pack/skills/intention-framer/SKILL.md): decides whether a workshop deserves to exist and what it must produce.
- [agenda-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/workshop-pack/skills/agenda-designer/SKILL.md): designs blocks, exercises, timings, group splits, and the energy curve.
- [pre-work-drafter](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/workshop-pack/skills/pre-work-drafter/SKILL.md): writes the invitation, pre-read, and facilitator briefing.
- [run-sheet-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/workshop-pack/skills/run-sheet-builder/SKILL.md): builds the facilitators pack and run sheet.
- [live-capturer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/workshop-pack/skills/live-capturer/SKILL.md): structures what the room produced, during and right after the session.
- [synthesis-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/workshop-pack/skills/synthesis-writer/SKILL.md): writes the follow-up and the synthesis within 48 hours.
- [workshop-retro](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/workshop-pack/skills/workshop-retro/SKILL.md): runs the facilitation debrief and writes the retro note.

### Annual Review Cycle Pack

- [cycle-setup](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/review-cycle-pack/skills/cycle-setup/SKILL.md): guided setup of the workspace, Project, and files. Everyone runs it first.
- [cycle-planner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/review-cycle-pack/skills/cycle-planner/SKILL.md): builds the cycle calendar, team context, and company direction (founder).
- [growth-matrix-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/review-cycle-pack/skills/growth-matrix-builder/SKILL.md): drafts levels and competencies (founder).
- [review-form-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/review-cycle-pack/skills/review-form-builder/SKILL.md): creates the self and manager review forms (founder).
- [comms-drafter](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/review-cycle-pack/skills/comms-drafter/SKILL.md): kickoff memo, reminders, wrap-up (founder).
- [cycle-retro](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/review-cycle-pack/skills/cycle-retro/SKILL.md): closes the cycle and improves next year's plan (founder).
- [review-prepper](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/review-cycle-pack/skills/review-prepper/SKILL.md): evidence sheet and growth memo per direct report (manager).
- [one-on-one-companion](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/review-cycle-pack/skills/one-on-one-companion/SKILL.md): briefs a manager before every 1:1 and review conversation (manager).
- [brag-doc-keeper](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/review-cycle-pack/skills/brag-doc-keeper/SKILL.md): logs wins through the year (employee).
- [self-review-prepper](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/review-cycle-pack/skills/self-review-prepper/SKILL.md): interviews and drafts the self-review (employee).
- [growth-navigator](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/review-cycle-pack/skills/growth-navigator/SKILL.md): finds the aspiration and builds a personal growth profile (employee).

### Design Thinking Pack

- [design-challenge-framer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/design-challenge-framer/SKILL.md): turns a fuzzy ask into a proper design challenge brief.
- [stakeholder-mapper](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/stakeholder-mapper/SKILL.md): maps everyone who touches, decides, or blocks a design challenge.
- [assumption-mapper](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/assumption-mapper/SKILL.md): separates what the team believes from what it knows and ranks the risk.
- [desk-research-digest](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/desk-research-digest/SKILL.md): digests what's already known before new research spends anyone's time.
- [interview-guide-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/interview-guide-designer/SKILL.md): designs interview guides that open people up.
- [participant-screener-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/participant-screener-builder/SKILL.md): builds screener surveys that recruit the right research participants.
- [survey-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/survey-designer/SKILL.md): designs short unbiased surveys that measure instead of flatter.
- [observation-plan-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/observation-plan-builder/SKILL.md): plans shadowing sessions and field visits.
- [diary-study-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/diary-study-designer/SKILL.md): designs diary studies for behavior that interviews can't reach.
- [research-kickoff-brief](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/research-kickoff-brief/SKILL.md): writes the one-pager that aligns everyone before research starts.
- [interview-debriefer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/interview-debriefer/SKILL.md): turns one interview into structured notes within 24 hours.
- [transcript-synthesizer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/transcript-synthesizer/SKILL.md): finds patterns across interview transcripts and debriefs.
- [survey-analyzer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/survey-analyzer/SKILL.md): analyzes survey results with statistical honesty.
- [insight-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/insight-writer/SKILL.md): turns research findings into insight statements that provoke ideas.
- [empathy-map-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/empathy-map-builder/SKILL.md): builds empathy maps from real research data.
- [persona-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/persona-designer/SKILL.md): builds personas from real research data.
- [jtbd-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/jtbd-writer/SKILL.md): writes jobs-to-be-done statements from research.
- [journey-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/journey-builder/SKILL.md): builds the current-state journey map across all touchpoints.
- [five-whys-runner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/five-whys-runner/SKILL.md): runs evidence-backed root-cause laddering on a chosen pain.
- [problem-statement-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/problem-statement-writer/SKILL.md): writes POV problem statements from research insights.
- [hmw-generator](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/hmw-generator/SKILL.md): generates the How Might We question set from POVs and insights.
- [idea-expander](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/idea-expander/SKILL.md): expands the idea space beyond the first obvious directions.
- [concept-card-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/concept-card-writer/SKILL.md): writes one-page concept cards in a consistent format.
- [value-impact-matrix](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/value-impact-matrix/SKILL.md): prioritizes concepts on a calibrated 2x2 matrix.
- [dfv-checker](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/dfv-checker/SKILL.md): stress tests concepts for desirability, feasibility, and viability.
- [role-play-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/role-play-designer/SKILL.md): designs role-play walkthroughs for service concepts.
- [storyboard-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/storyboard-writer/SKILL.md): writes the concept as a storyboard the user would live.
- [riskiest-assumption-finder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/riskiest-assumption-finder/SKILL.md): finds the assumption that kills each concept and prices its test.
- [prototype-planner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/prototype-planner/SKILL.md): plans the cheapest prototype that answers the question.
- [test-script-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/test-script-designer/SKILL.md): writes usability and concept test scripts that don't lead the witness.
- [test-debrief-synthesizer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/test-debrief-synthesizer/SKILL.md): synthesizes what really happened across test sessions.
- [insight-playback-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/insight-playback-builder/SKILL.md): builds the client or stakeholder playback of the research and testing story.
- [recommendation-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/skills/recommendation-writer/SKILL.md): writes the decision-ready close of a design project.

### Onboarding Pack

- [onboarding-setup](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/onboarding-pack/skills/onboarding-setup/SKILL.md): guided setup of the workspace, Project, and company context file. Everyone runs it first.
- [preboarding-planner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/onboarding-pack/skills/preboarding-planner/SKILL.md): builds the plan from signed offer to day one, with owners and dates (onboarding owner).
- [onboarding-comms-drafter](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/onboarding-pack/skills/onboarding-comms-drafter/SKILL.md): drafts the internal emails to IT, finance, and workspace, plus the keep-warm notes (onboarding owner).
- [welcome-brief-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/onboarding-pack/skills/welcome-brief-writer/SKILL.md): writes the cultural brief sent a few days before day one, and the congratulations choreography (onboarding owner).
- [welcome-pack-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/onboarding-pack/skills/welcome-pack-designer/SKILL.md): designs the welcome pack a joiner actually keeps (onboarding owner).
- [onboarding-checklist-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/onboarding-pack/skills/onboarding-checklist-builder/SKILL.md): builds the per-joiner checklist and the tickable dashboard (onboarding owner).
- [joiner-companion-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/onboarding-pack/skills/joiner-companion-builder/SKILL.md): builds the policy-answering assistant new joiners ask instead of you (onboarding owner).
- [team-deck-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/onboarding-pack/skills/team-deck-builder/SKILL.md): builds the four-layer intro deck: company, function, team, person (hiring manager).
- [team-intro-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/onboarding-pack/skills/team-intro-writer/SKILL.md): writes the email that introduces the joiner to the whole team (hiring manager).
- [first-goals-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/onboarding-pack/skills/first-goals-writer/SKILL.md): drafts the first goals and prepares the ways-of-working session (hiring manager).
- [week-one-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/onboarding-pack/skills/week-one-designer/SKILL.md): designs the pre-booked first week: who they meet, when, and why (hiring manager).
- [my-first-90](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/onboarding-pack/skills/my-first-90/SKILL.md): the joiner's own companion for their first 90 days (new joiner).

### Design Sprint Pack

- [sprint-qualifier](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/sprint-qualifier/SKILL.md): tests whether a design sprint is the right tool and writes the memo, including the words to say when the answer is no.
- [challenge-framer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/challenge-framer/SKILL.md): writes the long-term goal, the sprint questions, the challenge statement, and the sprint brief every other skill reads.
- [sprint-cast-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/sprint-cast-builder/SKILL.md): casts the Decider and the seven seats, lines up the experts, writes the pre-reads, and builds the hour-by-hour calendar.
- [test-recruiter](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/test-recruiter/SKILL.md): gets five real target users booked for the test day: screener, sourcing, incentives, scheduling, consent.
- [sprint-facilitator-kit](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/sprint-facilitator-kit/SKILL.md): the room craft: timeboxing, silent work, the people problems, energy across five days, and remote facilitation.
- [map-and-target-runner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/map-and-target-runner/SKILL.md): runs day one: the goal check, the map, the expert interviews, and the Decider's target choice.
- [sketch-day-runner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/sketch-day-runner/SKILL.md): runs sketch day: Lightning Demos, the four-step sketch, and machine concepts that compete only once adopted by a human.
- [decision-day-runner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/decision-day-runner/SKILL.md): runs the decision: art museum, heat map, speed critique, straw poll, and the Decider's supervote.
- [storyboard-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/storyboard-builder/SKILL.md): turns the winning sketches into a fifteen-panel storyboard with a real opening scene.
- [prototype-plan-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/prototype-plan-writer/SKILL.md): plans and staffs the build day, decides what is real and what is facade, and writes the prototype's content.
- [test-script-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/test-script-writer/SKILL.md): writes the five-act interview script and sets up the note grid the room fills live.
- [friday-debrief-synthesizer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/friday-debrief-synthesizer/SKILL.md): turns the five test sessions into an answer, with each sprint question marked yes, no or unclear.
- [monday-after-planner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/skills/monday-after-planner/SKILL.md): converts the result into a decision record, a named owner, a two-week plan, and the evidence a sponsor will ask for.

### DesignOps Pack

- [team-ops-mapper](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/designops-pack/skills/team-ops-mapper/SKILL.md): interviews the design lead and writes the map of how the team actually works today: rituals, handoffs, tools, decisions, pains.
- [critique-ritual-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/designops-pack/skills/critique-ritual-designer/SKILL.md): designs the critique ritual: cadence, format, roles, rules for givers and receivers, and the objectives work is assessed against.
- [critique-session-preparer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/designops-pack/skills/critique-session-preparer/SKILL.md): prepares one critique (brief, framing question, timebox) and turns the presenter's notes into next steps afterwards.
- [handoff-standard-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/designops-pack/skills/handoff-standard-writer/SKILL.md): writes the definition of ready for design-to-engineering handoff: package contents, states, edge cases, tokens, motion, and the conversation.
- [handoff-package-checker](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/designops-pack/skills/handoff-package-checker/SKILL.md): checks one handoff package against the team's standard and lists what is missing, as process flags rather than blame.
- [system-governance-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/designops-pack/skills/system-governance-designer/SKILL.md): designs design-system governance sized for a small team: ownership, change path, versioning, deprecation, decision-record format.
- [system-change-recorder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/designops-pack/skills/system-change-recorder/SKILL.md): runs one proposed system change through the governance rules and writes the decision record; a person still makes the call.
- [file-hygiene-standard-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/designops-pack/skills/file-hygiene-standard-writer/SKILL.md): writes the file and tool conventions: naming, project structure, cover and status pages, archiving, branching, what lives where.
- [request-intake-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/designops-pack/skills/request-intake-designer/SKILL.md): designs the front door for design requests: the brief, the triage rules behind yes, not-yet and no, and how the answer is communicated.
- [capacity-planner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/designops-pack/skills/capacity-planner/SKILL.md): plans a week, month or quarter at team level: supply versus demand, what to defer, and the wording for the no. Never a per-person load report.
- [designer-onboarding-planner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/designops-pack/skills/designer-onboarding-planner/SKILL.md): builds a 30/60/90 plan bringing one new designer into the ways of working: buddy, first critique, first handoff, first system contribution.
- [ways-of-working-handbook-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/designops-pack/skills/ways-of-working-handbook-writer/SKILL.md): compiles every standard the team has written into one readable handbook and flags where they contradict each other.

### Innovation Pack

- [program-charter-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/innovation-pack/skills/program-charter-writer/SKILL.md): writes the one-page charter for the program: purpose, what counts as an initiative, target ambition mix, money and time envelope, decision rights, review rhythm.
- [stage-gate-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/innovation-pack/skills/stage-gate-designer/SKILL.md): designs the stages and gates: one decision per gate, questions instead of scores, a funding round per stage, a way back one stage, kill criteria agreed up front.
- [innovation-ledger-keeper](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/innovation-pack/skills/innovation-ledger-keeper/SKILL.md): keeps the innovation accounting: leading indicators per initiative and stage, plus cycle time, kill rate, learning velocity and money by stage.
- [portfolio-mapper](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/innovation-pack/skills/portfolio-mapper/SKILL.md): maps every live initiative on ambition and stage, compares the mix against the charter, and names where the portfolio is crowded and where it is empty.
- [innovation-challenge-framer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/innovation-pack/skills/innovation-challenge-framer/SKILL.md): turns a strategy gap, a portfolio hole or a client signal into a challenge brief: the problem, who has it, the boundaries, what is out.
- [ideation-session-runner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/innovation-pack/skills/ideation-session-runner/SKILL.md): designs and runs the ideation format the challenge needs, keeps seniority out of selection, and turns the output into idea one-pagers.
- [discovery-interview-planner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/innovation-pack/skills/discovery-interview-planner/SKILL.md): plans the customer conversations an idea needs before anything is built: who, how many, the guide, consent, notes, and synthesis into evidence.
- [experiment-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/innovation-pack/skills/experiment-designer/SKILL.md): maps the assumptions, picks the riskiest, and writes an experiment card with pass and fail thresholds set before the experiment runs.
- [experiment-results-reader](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/innovation-pack/skills/experiment-results-reader/SKILL.md): reads results against the card's thresholds, records the learning, and prepares a scale, pivot, persevere or kill recommendation for a human to sign.
- [gate-review-preparer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/innovation-pack/skills/gate-review-preparer/SKILL.md): prepares one initiative for one gate: the one-page evidence brief, the reviewer's questions, the 10-minute script, and the decision record with a named signer.
- [investment-case-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/innovation-pack/skills/investment-case-writer/SKILL.md): writes the quarterly or annual case for continued investment: what was learned, what was stopped and why, the portfolio against target, and the next round's cost.
- [initiative-sunset-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/innovation-pack/skills/initiative-sunset-writer/SKILL.md): closes an initiative: the sunset memo, the harvest of reusable assets, the honest reasons, and the message that separates the decision from the people.

### Employer Branding Pack

- [evidence-interview-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/skills/evidence-interview-designer/SKILL.md): designs the listening round: who to talk to across roles and tenure, the stay-interview guide, the consent script, and the note-taking rule.
- [peer-claims-mapper](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/skills/peer-claims-mapper/SKILL.md): maps the claims on 5 to 10 peer firms' careers pages and job ads into table stakes, rare and specific, and names the phrases your EVP must not lean on.
- [evidence-synthesizer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/skills/evidence-synthesizer/SKILL.md): turns the interview notes, exit notes and verbatims into the evidence base: themes with counts, the minority view kept, contradictions named.
- [evp-from-evidence-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/skills/evp-from-evidence-writer/SKILL.md): writes the EVP as Give and Get pairs from the evidence base, tags each claim by evidence strength, and lists what the firm cannot claim yet.
- [careers-page-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/skills/careers-page-writer/SKILL.md): writes the careers page from the EVP: what it is like here, the hard parts, who should not apply, how hiring works, pay policy, approved quotes only.
- [job-ad-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/skills/job-ad-writer/SKILL.md): writes one job ad that rules people out on purpose: the real first 90 days, the give and the get, who will dislike it, the pay range, the process with dates.
- [realistic-preview-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/skills/realistic-preview-builder/SKILL.md): builds a realistic job preview from a conversation with the person doing the job today: a written “a real week” piece, plus a video script and shot list if wanted.
- [team-voice-editor](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/skills/team-voice-editor/SKILL.md): interviews a colleague, structures their own answers into a draft, marks what was rearranged, and hands it back to them to finish.
- [hiring-content-planner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/skills/hiring-content-planner/SKILL.md): plans a quarter of hiring content where every piece maps to one EVP claim and one willing owner, and shows evidence rather than asserting it.
- [brand-measure-designer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/skills/brand-measure-designer/SKILL.md): designs the five or six measures that mean something at a few hires a year, and how to collect each without tracking individuals.
- [first-weeks-promise-checker](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/skills/first-weeks-promise-checker/SKILL.md): prepares the week 1, 4 and 12 conversations from the claims the joiner read before applying, and turns approved answers into flags on the process.
- [brand-review-runner](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/skills/brand-review-runner/SKILL.md): runs the quarterly review: promotes or demotes each EVP claim on new evidence and separates fix-the-words from fix-the-workplace, with owners and dates.

### Case Study Factory Pack

- [case-interviewer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/case-study-factory-pack/skills/case-interviewer/SKILL.md): runs the thirty-minute interview with the person who ran the project, one question at a time, and writes the case source file every other skill reads.
- [website-case-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/case-study-factory-pack/skills/website-case-writer/SKILL.md): writes the short web case, 400 to 700 words: the snapshot, the honest before, what was done, what changed with its base and period, one quote, one takeaway.
- [long-read-case-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/case-study-factory-pack/skills/long-read-case-writer/SKILL.md): writes the long read, 1,500 to 2,500 words in magazine shape, with the decisions, the missteps, an image list and captions.
- [case-one-pager-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/case-study-factory-pack/skills/case-one-pager-builder/SKILL.md): builds the A4 leave-behind as a real PowerPoint file, and a PDF when it can export one, in the firm's colors and type, through code execution.
- [case-two-pager-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/case-study-factory-pack/skills/case-two-pager-builder/SKILL.md): builds the two-page case as a real PowerPoint file: page one the story, page two the approach, the results, the quote, the next step.
- [credentials-slide-builder](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/case-study-factory-pack/skills/credentials-slide-builder/SKILL.md): builds the one case slide for the credentials deck, inside the firm's own deck template when given one: the change in the title, three lines, one to three figures, logo if allowed.
- [linkedin-case-post-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/case-study-factory-pack/skills/linkedin-case-post-writer/SKILL.md): writes the post from the firm's account and the first-person post from the lead, plus a carousel outline, with the anti-slop rules built in.
- [award-entry-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/case-study-factory-pack/skills/award-entry-writer/SKILL.md): recommends the category, then writes the entry inside the form's word counts and rules for a jury reader, with results only from the source file.
- [proposal-case-paragraph-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/case-study-factory-pack/skills/proposal-case-paragraph-writer/SKILL.md): writes the 120 to 180 word proof paragraph for a proposal or an RFP answer, matched to the prospect's situation without bending the facts, plus a 40-word version.
- [case-video-script-writer](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/case-study-factory-pack/skills/case-video-script-writer/SKILL.md): writes a 60 to 90 second script for the lead or the client to say on camera, with a shot list and lower thirds, from lines that were actually said.

## Reference

- [templates/](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/review-cycle-pack/templates): the Review Cycle Pack's shared files — team-context.md, growth-matrix.md, company-direction.md, review-form.md (blanks the founder's skills fill in) and question-bank.md (ships complete, for 1:1s).
- [exercise-bank.md](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/packs/workshop-pack/resources/exercise-bank.md): the workshop format library — openers, ideation (Crazy 8s, brainwriting 6-3-5, SCAMPER), convergence, decision, and closing exercises with timing, materials, scripts, and failure modes.
- [templates/](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/design-thinking-pack/templates): the Design Thinking Pack's shared files — challenge-brief-template.md, concept-card-template.md, interview-debrief-template.md, journey-map-template.md and research-kickoff-template.md. Each also ships inside the skill that fills it in.
- [templates/](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/onboarding-pack/templates): the Onboarding Pack's shared file — company-onboarding-context.md, the standing setup (who plays which role, the systems a joiner needs, the start-date rhythm, the practical facts) that onboarding-setup fills in once and every skill reads.
- [templates/](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/design-sprint-pack/templates): the Design Sprint Pack's shared files — sprint-brief.md, the one page holding the goal, sprint questions, challenge statement, variant, cast and dates that challenge-framer fills in and every other skill reads, and friday-notes-grid.md, the blank grid the room fills live during the five test interviews.
- The DesignOps Pack ships no shared files: each skill reads the standards the earlier skills wrote, by file name, inside the team's DesignOps Studio project.
- The Innovation Pack ships no shared files: each skill reads the artifacts the earlier skills wrote — the charter, the gate rules, the ledger, the experiment cards — by file name, inside the firm's Innovation HQ project.
- [templates/](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/employer-branding-pack/templates): the Employer Branding Pack's shared files — firm-context.md, filled once by the founder and read by every skill; interview-notes.md, one per listening conversation and the only thing the synthesizer reads about individuals; and first-weeks-check.md, which the joiner fills at week 1, 4 and 12 and decides what to share from.
- [templates/](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/tree/main/packs/case-study-factory-pack/templates): the Case Study Factory Pack's shared files — firm-context.md, filled once by a founder or lead (positioning, tone, the words never used, colors and type, how clients are named, who signs off) and read by every skill before it writes; and case-source.md, the blank case-interviewer fills from the conversation, one per project, and the only source every writer in the pack reads.
- [catalog.json](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/catalog.json): machine-readable index of every pack and skill.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to create a pack, add an existing one, add a skill, or edit one.
- [docs/installing.md](https://github.com/polar-bear-org/claude-skills/blob/main/docs/installing.md): all installation paths in detail.

## About

Made by Polar Bear, a people ops consultancy for teams of 20–200, founded by ex-McKinsey consultants. Free to use inside your company, not for resale.

## Compassionate Leadership Pack

20 skills for founders and managers: feedback, conflict, workload, grief, change, exits, and more human workplaces. Includes Claude-native skills and portable ChatGPT/other-assistant prompts.

- Overview: packs/compassionate-leadership-pack/README.md
- Skill index: packs/compassionate-leadership-pack/catalog.json
- Research notes: packs/compassionate-leadership-pack/resources/evidence-and-sources.md
- Portable project source: packs/compassionate-leadership-pack/portable/ALL-SKILLS.md

## 10 Skills for Stakeholder Relationships
- Pack: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/README.md
- stakeholder-relationship-map: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/skills/stakeholder-relationship-map/SKILL.md — A recurring stakeholder relationship is slowing delivery; map dependencies and choose a practical starting point.
- stakeholder-get-perspective: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/skills/stakeholder-get-perspective/SKILL.md — You think you know why a stakeholder behaves this way; prepare questions and update your understanding from their actual answers.
- stakeholder-interests-and-constraints: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/skills/stakeholder-interests-and-constraints/SKILL.md — Stakeholders want incompatible things; identify real constraints and develop a mutually workable arrangement.
- stakeholder-trust-check: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/skills/stakeholder-trust-check/SKILL.md — A stakeholder says they do not trust your team; translate the concern into evidence and a bounded response.
- stakeholder-reliability-trial: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/skills/stakeholder-reliability-trial/SKILL.md — Good intentions have not improved a stakeholder relationship; create a small commitment people can verify.
- stakeholder-repair-plan: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/skills/stakeholder-repair-plan/SKILL.md — Your team has harmed an ongoing stakeholder relationship; prepare acknowledgment and a credible repair process.
- stakeholder-interface-agreement: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/skills/stakeholder-interface-agreement/SKILL.md — Repeated friction happens at approvals and handoffs between teams or organizations; agree how the interface works.
- stakeholder-update-and-warning: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/skills/stakeholder-update-and-warning/SKILL.md — A stakeholder hears about problems too late or receives too much reporting; design an honest update rhythm.
- stakeholder-boundaries-and-escalation: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/skills/stakeholder-boundaries-and-escalation/SKILL.md — Repeated demands or harmful conduct are overwhelming the relationship; choose a proportionate boundary and escalation route.
- stakeholder-relationship-review: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/skills/stakeholder-relationship-review/SKILL.md — A stakeholder agreement or repair trial has run for a few weeks; review evidence and decide what to change.
- Reference: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/resources/evidence-and-sources.md
- Reference: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/resources/practice-lab.md
- Reference: packs/stakeholder-relationships-pack/templates/relationship-tools.md

## 8 Skills for Failures and Mistakes
- Pack: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/README.md
- failure-contain-the-incident: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/skills/failure-contain-the-incident/SKILL.md — A mistake is still affecting a client, delivery, or team.
- failure-own-and-repair: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/skills/failure-own-and-repair/SKILL.md — You caused or own an error and need an accountable response.
- failure-reconstruct-the-event: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/skills/failure-reconstruct-the-event/SKILL.md — Accounts conflict or hindsight is replacing evidence after an error.
- failure-map-contributing-conditions: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/skills/failure-map-contributing-conditions/SKILL.md — The explanation has stopped at carelessness, poor communication, or one root cause.
- failure-respond-to-a-reported-error: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/skills/failure-respond-to-a-reported-error/SKILL.md — Someone tells you about a mistake or near miss and your response will affect future reporting.
- failure-recover-for-learning: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/skills/failure-recover-for-learning/SKILL.md — Shame or defensive thinking is making a factual review difficult.
- failure-test-a-prevention-change: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/skills/failure-test-a-prevention-change/SKILL.md — A review produced recommendations but no evidence that they work.
- failure-close-and-transfer-learning: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/skills/failure-close-and-transfer-learning/SKILL.md — Repairs are complete but lessons may be forgotten or copied too widely.
- Reference: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/resources/evidence-and-sources.md
- Reference: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/resources/practice-lab.md
- Reference: packs/failures-and-mistakes-pack/templates/incident-and-learning.md

## 10 Skills for Delegation
- Pack: packs/delegation-pack/README.md
- delegation-task-picker: packs/delegation-pack/skills/delegation-task-picker/SKILL.md — A task shortlist with reasons, retained decisions, and a first handoff. Part of Polar Bear's Delegation Pack.
- delegation-capacity-check: packs/delegation-pack/skills/delegation-capacity-check/SKILL.md — A feasible scope and a concrete workload trade-off. Part of Polar Bear's Delegation Pack.
- delegation-outcome-brief: packs/delegation-pack/skills/delegation-outcome-brief/SKILL.md — A one-page brief defining useful completion without prescribing every method. Part of Polar Bear's Delegation Pack.
- delegation-authority-map: packs/delegation-pack/skills/delegation-authority-map/SKILL.md — An explicit decision map and escalation boundaries. Part of Polar Bear's Delegation Pack.
- delegation-handoff-conversation: packs/delegation-pack/skills/delegation-handoff-conversation/SKILL.md — A short conversation guide and an agreement awaiting human confirmation. Part of Polar Bear's Delegation Pack.
- delegation-checkpoint-plan: packs/delegation-pack/skills/delegation-checkpoint-plan/SKILL.md — A small review schedule tied to risks and decisions. Part of Polar Bear's Delegation Pack.
- delegation-coach-without-taking-over: packs/delegation-pack/skills/delegation-coach-without-taking-over/SKILL.md — A support conversation that resolves the blocker and makes ownership explicit. Part of Polar Bear's Delegation Pack.
- delegation-reset-handoff: packs/delegation-pack/skills/delegation-reset-handoff/SKILL.md — A recovery agreement addressing outcome, capacity, authority, and support. Part of Polar Bear's Delegation Pack.
- delegation-close-and-learn: packs/delegation-pack/skills/delegation-close-and-learn/SKILL.md — A completion decision and one change for the next handoff. Part of Polar Bear's Delegation Pack.
- delegation-pattern-review: packs/delegation-pack/skills/delegation-pattern-review/SKILL.md — A fairer distribution experiment and a manager commitment. Part of Polar Bear's Delegation Pack.

## 10 Skills for Changing Ways of Working
- Pack: packs/ways-of-working-change-pack/README.md
- change-behavior-brief: packs/ways-of-working-change-pack/skills/change-behavior-brief/SKILL.md — Turn a vague transformation into one observable work change.
- change-barrier-diagnosis: packs/ways-of-working-change-pack/skills/change-barrier-diagnosis/SKILL.md — Diagnose obstacles before selecting training or reminders.
- change-involvement-plan: packs/ways-of-working-change-pack/skills/change-involvement-plan/SKILL.md — Design input that can influence the change.
- change-capacity-check: packs/ways-of-working-change-pack/skills/change-capacity-check/SKILL.md — Make space and support for a work change.
- change-pilot-design: packs/ways-of-working-change-pack/skills/change-pilot-design/SKILL.md — Test a work change with predictions and stop rules.
- change-practice-support: packs/ways-of-working-change-pack/skills/change-practice-support/SKILL.md — Create practice and point-of-use support for a specific barrier.
- change-adoption-evidence: packs/ways-of-working-change-pack/skills/change-adoption-evidence/SKILL.md — Distinguish use, usefulness and unintended effects.
- change-adaptation-review: packs/ways-of-working-change-pack/skills/change-adaptation-review/SKILL.md — Decide whether a local variation preserves the work change.
- change-rollout-decision: packs/ways-of-working-change-pack/skills/change-rollout-decision/SKILL.md — Turn pilot evidence into a proportionate rollout decision.

## 10 Skills to Make Time for Your Top Priorities
- Pack: packs/top-priorities-pack/README.md
- priorities-choose-outcomes: packs/top-priorities-pack/skills/priorities-choose-outcomes/SKILL.md — Everything feels important and you need a defensible short list. Produces a ranked outcome brief and an explicit not-now list.
- priorities-time-audit: packs/top-priorities-pack/skills/priorities-time-audit/SKILL.md — Your stated priorities and actual use of time do not match. Produces a light time audit with two changes worth testing.
- priorities-capacity-plan: packs/top-priorities-pack/skills/priorities-capacity-plan/SKILL.md — You have more promised work than time available. Produces a capacity calculation and a workable commitment proposal.
- priorities-calendar-reset: packs/top-priorities-pack/skills/priorities-calendar-reset/SKILL.md — Meetings and recurring commitments crowd out a chosen priority. Produces a proposed calendar reset with preserved coordination.
- priorities-focus-session: packs/top-priorities-pack/skills/priorities-focus-session/SKILL.md — You have protected time but keep delaying or spreading attention across tasks. Produces a small concrete work session with a restart note.
- priorities-interruptions: packs/top-priorities-pack/skills/priorities-interruptions/SKILL.md — Reactive work repeatedly derails your main task. Produces an interruption agreement and concise resumption routine.
- priorities-renegotiate: packs/top-priorities-pack/skills/priorities-renegotiate/SKILL.md — A new request would displace work already promised. Produces a factual trade-off brief and a draft response.
- priorities-realistic-plan: packs/top-priorities-pack/skills/priorities-realistic-plan/SKILL.md — An important outcome keeps slipping despite repeated intentions. Produces a staged plan with evidence-based estimates and contingencies.
- priorities-close-day: packs/top-priorities-pack/skills/priorities-close-day/SKILL.md — Unfinished work follows you into the evening or causes a confused restart. Produces a short closure note and a realistic next working-day entry point.
- priorities-weekly-review: packs/top-priorities-pack/skills/priorities-weekly-review/SKILL.md — Your plan needs updating after a week of real work. Produces a short evidence-based review and next-week commitment change.
